description: Monitor estimator innovations and covariance-normalized residuals for configured consistency limits.
implementation_notes: This is a proposed roadmap item; the current UEF specification does not define its API or equations. Purpose: Monitor estimator innovations and covariance-normalized residuals for configured consistency limits. Family contract work: declare state and measurement ordering, process/measurement models, covariance/noise assumptions, timestamp and missing-measurement policy, innovation handling, and PSD-preserving updates. Specify a direct C API first; add a UEF-owned generated wrapper only after the same behavior is implemented and reviewed. Keep registered=false and outputs empty.
